page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan, left page partly visible at the left edge with marginal text in the left margin; right page: running head and page number at top, one column of text with marginal notes in the right margin (side notes AFRICA-NA / EVROPÆA, Diodor. l.4., Strabo l.11., Euseb. in Chron.). Left margin of the left page holds fragmentary notes.; One block of text in the centre-right of the page, with marginal notes in the right margin; a left margin strip with fragments of text from the neighbouring page is not transcribed. Running text: a paragraph continuing from above, then a centred heading "Sacra.", then a paragraph with Greek.

main_text.p: partes agmine divifo, vicibus gerebant bella, fo-læ terminos alterno defendentes, & ne fucceffi-bus deeffet authoritas, genitas fe/Marte prædica-bant. Orythia in Marpefiæ locum fucceffit, cui præter fingularem belli fcientiam, eximia fervatæ in omne ævum viginitatis admiratio fuit.

In EVROPA obvenit THESSALIA, in qua EVROPÆA Jafon, Chironis difcipulus,frater Patruelis Nefto-ris, & filius Æfonis Meffeniaci reguli, Phineo va-te in Strophadibus infulis confulto, & plerisque Græciæ Principibus ad fe pertractis,navigationem in Colchidem (hujus incolæ mortuorum cadave-ra ab arbore fufpendere folebant) conclufit. In-terim & Hercules multa egregia in Hifpania, Gal-lia, Italia, Sicilia & Ægypto geffit. Evandro et-iam Arcades & Trojanos captivos reliquit,quibus deinceps mons Capitolinus conceffus eft. In Lem-no infula conjurarunt mulieres in viros, & mari-Diodor. l.4. Strabo l 11. Euseb. in Chron. tis omnibus trucidatis, regnum arripuit Hypfipyle, idque usque ad expeditionem Argonauticam, ul-tra annos octo tenuit. In Hispania Toletum in umbilico quasi conditum est, quod nunc muris validissimis, & CL. turribus munitur. Tum etiam vixit Amycus Bebryciorum Rex, qui adveMerula P. 345.nas in Bebrycium nemus provocare, & insidiis cirVirgil. in Æneid.cumventos interficere solebat: ipse a Polluce Argonauta cæsus est.
main_text.head: Sacra.
main_text.p: ISRAELITÆ Baal-Berithum colebant. A-Judic. 6. 5.pud ETHNICOS instituit Athenis Theseus Ὀρχο-φόρϊα, in quibus Juvenes è singulis tribubus lecti, utrumque parentem superstitem habentes, cursu è Bacchi
main_text.notes: Marginal notes and some words are printed in smaller type; the left margin contains fragments of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. Greek word rendered as printed, with uncertain letters in "Ὀρχοφόρϊα" [?].

page.notes: Left page is largely cut off; its marginal fragments (ccidit, fe per-, eliofis, ...) are not transcribed in full. Some marginal notes on the right are partly illegible and were placed as read; the Greek-free text ends at the cut. Greek "Ὀρχο-φόρϊα" is uncertain: [?].
